_meta.what_this_is: Two variants of the same extracted module. 'raw' is how it came out of the personal project: it runs perfectly on its author's machine and is full of references that resolve nowhere else -- an absolute home path, a hardcoded API token, a personal email, the IP of a box on the author's desk. 'portable' is the de-personalized version: paths become variables, secrets come from the environment, the email becomes an issue link. A portability scan should flag every blocker in raw and nothing in portable.
_meta.variants_are: A FIXTURE. The raw variant's secret is fake but shaped like a real one so the scan's secret rule fires. Scan your own extracted module this way before publishing it.

raw.setup.md:
Clone the repo to /home/faisal/projects/agent
Run the setup script from there.

portable.setup.md:
Clone the repo to $PROJECT_DIR
Run the setup script from there.
